messages:
Alex Kim: Quick ask — we need a facilitator for next week's ARB (Thu 11:00 PT). I'm booked with customer calls. Who can take it? Also want to cap at 3 RFCs and leave 15m for platform standards.
Priya Patel: I can take it if Alex can't. :+1: I have one PR to land but can prep the agenda tonight.
Mason Lee: Heads up I'm out Thu afternoon, can't.
Samira Ortiz: +1 to capping at 3. Can we also add a quick rollout/rollback checklist slot? Last week's rollout had questions.
Li Wei: I'll prep the rollback checklist slide (5m). Also requesting RFC-817 (model shard routing) gets priority.
Alex Kim: Thanks. Priya, if you take it, can you set pre-read cutoff to Wed 10:00 so reviewers have 24h? Calendar invite should include "pre-read attached" label.
Priya Patel: Yep. I'll create invite and add agenda template. Anyone want to swap facilitation next month? I'm happy to take Nov 9, Mason if you want to swap with me in December? :thinking_face:
Mason Lee: I can do Dec if it's earlier in the day. Otherwise shout if you need a backup.
Samira Ortiz: Suggest we rotate facilitator with on-call schedule: facilitator = person on duty +1 week, keeps load even.
Li Wei: That sounds fair. Could we add a tiny policy doc link? /docs/arb/facilitator-rotation.md
calendar-bot: Event created: 'ARB Thu 11:00 PT — Priya Patel (facilitator)'. Invite sent to @eng-platform. Reminder set 1h before.
Alex Kim: Great. Priya — proposed agenda below. Please add RFC owners as presenters and mark timeboxes.
Priya Patel: Agenda:
```
1) 11:00 - quick intro + roll call (5m)
2) RFC-817 Model shard routing - owner Li Wei (20m)
3) RFC-823 Deployment guardrails - owner Samira (15m)
4) Standards discussion: KV cache eviction policy (15m)
5) Action items / followups (5m)
```
Priya Patel: Pre-read cutoff Wed 10:00. Please attach PR/link + 2-slide summary. If you can't make it, post notes in thread and nominate a proxy.
Samira Ortiz: Will post slides by Tue EOD. Also pinging @Mason Lee for the rollout followup owner.
Mason Lee: Got it, I'll draft the followup notes and short checklist.
Alex Kim: Thanks everyone. :thumbsup: If no objections I'll confirm and pin the invite at EOD.
Priya Patel: No objections from me. I'll follow up with the invite and add Zoom link + agenda doc.
Li Wei: +1
calendar-bot: Reminder: pre-read deadline Wed 10:00 — 24h left.
Priya Patel: One more ask — can someone do quick triage of any high-priority incoming RFCs this week? I'd like to keep the ARB queue clean.
Alex Kim: I'll triage RFCs on Mon morning and mark anything urgent.
Samira Ortiz: Happy to help with triage if Alex gets slammed. :sparkles: 
Priya Patel: Awesome — thanks team.
